result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a faded marked crosswalk across a side street. While sidewalks are present, the lack of clear traffic control signage and worn pavement markings create a less-than-ideal environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their effectiveness in alerting drivers to the presence of a pedestrian crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the center of the frame.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control Signage
hazards.description: There are no visible stop or yield signs at the intersection, which may lead to unpredictable vehicle movements and right-of-way confusion.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Mature trees and roadside vegetation may partially block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb lines on both sides of the side street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply new, high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings to improve the visibility of the crossing area.

interventions.title: Intersection Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs on the side street approach to regulate traffic flow and improve pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks along the roadway. The wide, unmarked expanse of asphalt creates a large, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians accessing the adjacent institutional building.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: A large expanse of asphalt at the intersection with no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks along the main roadway forces pedestrians to walk in the street or on unpaved grass.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk network along the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a well-maintained sidewalk bordering a green space and apartment buildings. While the environment is generally quiet, there is a lack of marked pedestrian crossings and traffic control measures at the visible curve.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing Point
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a curve near residential buildings increases risk for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway curve in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a relatively wide residential street can encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at the curve to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a sidewalk on one side but lacking one on the other. There are no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures visible, creating a wide, open roadway that may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the right side of the street have no paved walkway, forcing them onto the grass or into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated places for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at intersections or mid-block locations.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Add lane markings to narrow the perceived width of the road and consider speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.
